learning_outcomes.text: Forms the design infrastructure and components.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the course, presentation of its functioning. Receiving student suggestions and expectations. Functional design, design for strength, design for ease of use, transport, recycling, energy consumption rate, energy recovery.
Concept of design, components of design, stages of design, idea generation, shaping, example design study.

Explanation of design stages with examples, determination of needs and desires, definition of the assignment, determination of physical and other principles, pre-shaping, calculations, controls, final shaping, prototype, model, test, analysis, modification and manufacturing.

Brief review of physical principles used in design (friction, gravity, etc.), Measurement system design, Application: Design of an element or system to measure the temperature in a room, with all its stages, Engineering materials and selection.
Definition of seating need and design appropriate to the type of need.

Machine elements: Definition, classification, shaping and strength criteria. Screws (joining, motion transmission, material transmission, adjustment etc.), Flywheels (energy accumulation, energy storage, motion balancing, energy balance).
Concept of safety and reliability in design. Determination of safety factor and optimum. Concepts of Strength and Stress.
Definition of manufacturing need and design appropriate to the type of need.
Drive systems and applications: Mechanical drive, Hydraulic drive, Pneumatic drive, Electrical drive, Electro-Mechanical, Electro-Hydraulic, Electro-Pneumatic, Electro-Hydro-Mechanical drive, etc.

Experiment design, design of experiment components, design of experiment setup, design of measurement system, design of experiment philosophy, acquisition of experimental results, analysis of experimental results, interpretation of experimental results.
Problem-solving methods in design and application (Brainstorming).
Computer use in design, sensor use in design, motor selection, power transmission component selection, speed/torque change system selection, etc. Application.
Definition of transport need and design appropriate to the type of need. Application: Design of an in-plant transport system with all its stages.
Analysis and synthesis of completed designs.

assessment_methods.method: Contribution to overall success during the semester

assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with 50% from semester work and 50% from the final exam. Semester work consists of a Midterm Exam (50%) and an Assignment (50%).
